text.en:
The fifteen municipalities of the Province of Mindoro shall, in accordance with the provisions of
this Act, be reduced to eight, as follows:
1. The municipality of Lubang shall consist of its present territory and that of the municipality
of Looc, with the seat of the municipal government at the barrio of Tilic.
2. The municipality of Mamburao shall consist of its present territory and that of the
municipalities of Palauan and Abra de Ylog, with the seat of the municipal government at the
present municipality of Mamburao.
3. The municipality of Calapan shall consist of its present territory and that of the municipality
of Puerto Galera, with the seal of the municipal government at the present municipality of
4. The municipality of Pinamalayan shall consist of its present territory and that of the
municipality of Pola, with the seat of the municipal government at the present municipality of
Pinamalayan.
5. The municipality of Bulalacao shall consist of its present territory and that of the
municipalities of Mansalay and Mangarin, with the seat of the municipal government at the
present municipality of Bulalacao.
6. The municipality of Nanjan shall preserve its present boundaries.
7. The municipality of Sablayan shall preserve its present boundaries.
8. The municipality of Caluya shall preserve its present boundaries.
